description: The four the known pantheon does not speak of. They are not in pantheon.json on purpose: catalogue_identity() hashes that file, and a world would be retired every time one of these was touched. They are still exported, as absent, because hiding them is the game's job and not the generator's.

notes.noticing: Encounters the game has reported before this god will act at all. Below it the chance is exactly zero, not merely small: early playthroughs are guaranteed clean, which is what makes a first corruption read as an escalation the player caused rather than a bad roll.
notes.interest: Which god takes an interest is read from the world, never rolled. The counter says whether; the world says which.
notes.climb: Encounters above the noticing point, at which this god is certain to act if it is the most interested.

gods.name: The Long Thirst
gods.smite: the city stood and its people did not; what walked the walls afterward wore their faces

gods.name: The Glad Mother
gods.smite: the dead did not stay where they were put, and there were more of them each morning

gods.name: The Shape Beneath
gods.smite: nothing was destroyed; the gates opened on time and the wrong people gave the orders

gods.name: The Unwriting
gods.smite: the ground where it stood is on no map now, and the ley runs around the place it was
